device.description: 24-bit 41.7 kSPS delta-sigma ADC with 2-wire serial interface (DOUT/DRDY, SCLK)
device.note: ads1252.pdf (SBAS127D) p.2-3 pin configuration, electrical characteristics (data rate 41.7 kHz at CLK = 16 MHz, VDD 4.75-5.25 V), p.8 CLK vs data rate table, p.10-11 DOUT/DRDY, synchronization, p.12 power-down, serial interface, data format (Table III), Table II digital timing

pages: p.2-3 pin configuration, electrical characteristics (data rate 41.7 kHz at CLK = 16 MHz, VDD 4.75-5.25 V), p.8 CLK vs data rate table, p.10-11 DOUT/DRDY, synchronization, p.12 power-down, serial interface, data format (Table III), Table II digital timing
notModeled: conversion cycle tDRDY = 384 CLK = 24 us at the nominal CLK = 16 MHz; the data rate scales with CLK (the CLK pin is not used)

DOUT/DRDY partitioning: DRDY mode (t4 high 24 CLK, t2 low pulse 6 CLK = 375 ns, t3 high 6 CLK) then DOUT mode with the MSB on the pin (t7); modeled as an active-low ready pulse of t2 followed by the data; the t3 high period and t4 high before the next DRDY are not modeled
after more than 24 SCLKs DOUT/DRDY stays low until t4 (idle '0'); after an incomplete read the last bit read stays on the pin
synchronization (SCLK held high for 4 to 20 DOUT/DRDY periods resets the modulator) and power-down (SCLK held high for 20 periods; released on SCLK falling)
digital filter settling (5 to 6 conversions after a step; first valid data after power-up / sync)
variants: ADS1250-ADS1254 family: ADS1251 (20.8 kHz, 1 input), ADS1252 (41.7 kHz, 1 input), ADS1253 (20.8 kHz, 4 inputs) have separate datasheets and spec files
